goal: Provide realistic production-prototype operations and evaluation fixtures while keeping product-authored assumptions explicitly separate from official Furama facts.
runtime_default: Canonical official facts are guest-facing by default. Product-authored operational policy may drive workflow decisions, while synthetic facts, prices, credentials and inventory remain non-canonical and require the configured staff/tool gate before guest commitment.
production_gate: Production prototype allows product-authored routing and target timings as internal workflow policy. Any claim about Furama facilities, credentials, live inventory, price or completion status must come from canonical truth or an authorized live/staff-confirmed source.
demo_mode: Synthetic business fixtures exercise end-to-end concierge flows for testing and controlled prototype operation; they are never indexed as canonical RAG truth.
